Date: 2026-08-25
Tail-Risk Brief v2.0 — Morning Desk Section (pre-market America/Chicago)

# Section 0: Current Positions & Hypotheses

As of August 25, 2026 (~8:25 AM CT). Research framework, not trade recommendations.

**Book snapshot:** gross delta leverage 3.74x · net delta -148.5% · premium at risk 34.8% · theta -0.94%/day · cash liquidity 97.5%.
**Data note:** Live price snapshot via Yahoo chart API during pre-market; authored bear/base/bull levels and valuation metrics from the hypothesis table through Aug 24, 2026.

## 1. LYV

**Price:** $184.59 (+1.5%) | RSI(14): 61.1 | MACD histogram: +0.33
**Valuation:** Q2 revenue $7.7B | Q2 adjusted OI $817M | Event deferred revenue $6.4B
**Bear / Base / Bull:** $125.61 | $180.74 | $188.46
**Thesis:** Live Nation is a live-events demand and venue-capacity position. Record ticket sales and deferred revenue must convert into double-digit adjusted operating income and cash flow while legal remedies, capital intensity, weather, and artist or fan affordability do not impair the flywheel.
**Desk risk:** exposure -129.5% · capital 48.4% · premium at risk 12.2% · theta -0.08%/day · IV 32.3% · min DTE 143
**Latest:** Live Nation (NYSE: LYV) officer plans $533K stock sale — Stock Titan (Mon, 24 Aug 2026 20:50:33 GMT)
**Kill watch:** Bull reference $188.46 sits 2.1% above spot; if the tape squeezes through base $180.74 and holds, this short becomes a momentum problem before it becomes a valuation win.
**Action:** Hold the authored thesis; do not resize before fresh catalyst evidence.

![LYV RSI](charts/2026-08-25/lyv-rsi.png)

![LYV MACD](charts/2026-08-25/lyv-macd.png)

## 2. DASH

**Price:** $229.06 (+2.5%) | RSI(14): 65.9 | MACD histogram: +7.69
**Valuation:** Q2 Marketplace GOV $33.1B | Q2 revenue $4.5B | Q2 adjusted EBITDA $914M
**Bear / Base / Bull:** $146.60 | $215.79 | $281.74
**Thesis:** DoorDash is a local-commerce network position. Order and GOV growth, DashPass engagement, Deliveroo integration, and grocery/retail unit economics must compound faster than insurance, regulation, autonomy investment, and international complexity consume the margin upside.
**Desk risk:** exposure -110.6% · capital 47.6% · premium at risk 13.7% · theta -0.08%/day · IV 42.3% · min DTE 143
**Latest:** DASH Stock Pops 14% Premarket: CEO Wants To Merge DoorDash, Deliveroo And Wolt Into One Platform — Stocktwits (Sun, 23 Aug 2026 07:59:15 GMT)
**Kill watch:** Bull reference $281.74 sits 23.0% above spot; if the tape squeezes through base $215.79 and holds, this short becomes a momentum problem before it becomes a valuation win.
**Action:** Hold the authored thesis; do not resize before fresh catalyst evidence.

![DASH RSI](charts/2026-08-25/dash-rsi.png)

![DASH MACD](charts/2026-08-25/dash-macd.png)

## 3. INTU

**Price:** $369.92 (+0.8%) | RSI(14): 50.1 | MACD histogram: +19.18
**Valuation:** Fiscal Q3 revenue $8.6B | Online ecosystem growth +19% | Consumer growth +8%
**Bear / Base / Bull:** $253.95 | $361.87 | $709.24
**Thesis:** Intuit is an AI-driven financial-platform compounder. TurboTax Live, QuickBooks Online, Credit Karma, and mid-market growth must sustain double-digit revenue and margin expansion while AI competition, tax seasonality, and customer-trust risk do not erode the economics.
**Desk risk:** exposure +98.9% · capital 41.3% · premium at risk 5.0% · theta -0.77%/day · IV 107.1% · min DTE 3 · unstable delta
**Latest:** Intuit (INTU) Stock Looks Undervalued As It Expands Mid Market AI Tools — simplywall.st (Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:37:10 GMT)
**Kill watch:** Below $253.95 the authored bull case stops paying you; above base $361.87 the thesis is working, but time decay and sizing matter more than narrative.
**Action:** Hold the authored thesis; do not resize before fresh catalyst evidence.

![INTU RSI](charts/2026-08-25/intu-rsi.png)

![INTU MACD](charts/2026-08-25/intu-macd.png)

## 4. PAYX

**Price:** $126.01 (+1.2%) | RSI(14): 74.7 | MACD histogram: +3.16
**Valuation:** FY26 revenue $6.51B | FY26 operating income $2.51B | FY27 adj. EPS guide +7%–9%
**Bear / Base / Bull:** $83.61 | $119.93 | $134.87
**Thesis:** Paychex is a payroll and human-capital-management compounder with Paycor integration upside. Fiscal 2027 organic growth, cross-selling, and margin expansion must outrun acquisition amortization, debt costs, labor-market softness, and an expensive recurring-revenue multiple.
**Desk risk:** exposure -21.4% · capital 10.9% · premium at risk 1.7% · theta -0.01%/day · IV 36.6% · min DTE 143
**Latest:** Paychex (PAYX) Faces A Fresh Valuation Test Following The Paycor Perks Launch — simplywall.st (Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:38:15 GMT)
**Kill watch:** Bull reference $134.87 sits 7.0% above spot; if the tape squeezes through base $119.93 and holds, this short becomes a momentum problem before it becomes a valuation win.
**Action:** Hold the authored thesis; do not resize before fresh catalyst evidence.

![PAYX RSI](charts/2026-08-25/payx-rsi.png)

![PAYX MACD](charts/2026-08-25/payx-macd.png)

## 5. AVAV

**Price:** $148.20 (-7.5%) | RSI(14): 42.6 | MACD histogram: +2.29
**Valuation:** FY26 revenue $1.977B | Funded backlog $1.2B | FY27 revenue guide $2.125–2.225B
**Bear / Base / Bull:** $136.68 | $159.79 | $409.83
**Thesis:** AeroVironment is a defense-autonomy and unmanned-systems backlog-conversion position. BlueHalo integration, funded orders, and supply-chain execution must turn fiscal 2026's acquisition-led scale into durable organic growth, margins, and cash flow.
**Desk risk:** exposure +7.5% · capital 7.5% · premium at risk 0.0% · theta +0.00%/day
**Latest:** AVAV Stock Eyes Weekly Gain: AeroVironment CEO Sees ‘Unprecedented’ Defense Demand Over Next Two Years — Stocktwits (Sun, 23 Aug 2026 16:50:04 GMT)
**Kill watch:** Below $136.68 the authored bull case stops paying you; above base $159.79 the thesis is working, but time decay and sizing matter more than narrative.
**Action:** Hold the authored thesis; do not resize before fresh catalyst evidence.

![AVAV RSI](charts/2026-08-25/avav-rsi.png)

![AVAV MACD](charts/2026-08-25/avav-macd.png)

## 6. FRMI

**Price:** $5.62 (-5.1%) | RSI(14): 38.5 | MACD histogram: +0.27
**Valuation:** Market cap $5.6B | P/B 3.5× | Revenue Pre-commercial
**Bear / Base / Bull:** $4.47 | $7.26 | $15.00
**Thesis:** A development-stage bet on Project Matador becoming a scarce, gigawatt-scale powered AI campus. Commercial agreements and funded delivery—not headline capacity—must validate it.
**Desk risk:** exposure +6.4% · capital 5.0% · premium at risk 2.2% · theta -0.00%/day · IV 91.4% · min DTE 843

**Kill watch:** Below $4.47 the authored bull case stops paying you; above base $7.26 the thesis is working, but time decay and sizing matter more than narrative.
**Action:** Hold the authored thesis; do not resize before fresh catalyst evidence.

![FRMI RSI](charts/2026-08-25/frmi-rsi.png)

![FRMI MACD](charts/2026-08-25/frmi-macd.png)

## 7. APP

**Price:** $298.59 (-2.3%) | RSI(14): 34.9 | MACD histogram: -19.24
**Valuation:** Q2 revenue $1.924B | Q2 adjusted EBITDA $1.614B | Q2 free cash flow $863.3M
**Bear / Base / Bull:** $298.59 | $298.59 | $733.60
**Thesis:** AppLovin is an AI advertising-platform execution position. Axon must keep improving advertiser returns and scale beyond mobile gaming into web commerce while platform concentration, competition, privacy rules, and elevated expectations do not break the growth, margin, and cash-flow engine.
**Desk risk:** exposure +0.3% · capital 0.3% · premium at risk 0.0% · theta +0.00%/day
**Latest:** APP Stock Slumps After-Hours Despite Strong Q4 Earnings — Why Does Retail See This As A Buying Opportunity? — Stocktwits (Fri, 21 Aug 2026 03:55:09 GMT)
**Kill watch:** Below $298.59 the authored bull case stops paying you; above base $298.59 the thesis is working, but time decay and sizing matter more than narrative.
**Action:** Hold the authored thesis; do not resize before fresh catalyst evidence.

![APP RSI](charts/2026-08-25/app-rsi.png)

![APP MACD](charts/2026-08-25/app-macd.png)

## 8. BOT

**Price:** $26.71 (-2.6%) | RSI(14): 43.2 | MACD histogram: -0.23
**Valuation:** June 22 NAV/share $8.92 | June 22 total assets $192.5M | Est. annual expenses 3.98%
**Bear / Base / Bull:** $21.01 | $32.49 | $41.74
**Thesis:** RoboStrategy is a closed-end private-robotics access position. Monthly NAV growth and portfolio-company financing or liquidity events must outrun the stock's premium to stale Level 3 marks, a 3.98% estimated expense load, dilution, and weak price discovery.
**Desk risk:** exposure +0.0% · capital 0.0% · premium at risk 0.0% · theta +0.00%/day
**Latest:** China robot maker Unitree's post-listing slump sparks bubble fears — Reuters (Tue, 25 Aug 2026 02:14:00 GMT)
**Kill watch:** Below $21.01 the authored bull case stops paying you; above base $32.49 the thesis is working, but time decay and sizing matter more than narrative.
**Action:** Hold the authored thesis; do not resize before fresh catalyst evidence.

![BOT RSI](charts/2026-08-25/bot-rsi.png)

![BOT MACD](charts/2026-08-25/bot-macd.png)

## Risk/Reward ranking

| Ticker | Side | Price | Bear | Base | Bull | Ref read |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| LYV | short | $184.59 | $125.61 | $180.74 | $188.46 | 2.1% squeeze to bull |
| DASH | short | $229.06 | $146.60 | $215.79 | $281.74 | 23.0% squeeze to bull |
| INTU | long | $369.92 | $253.95 | $361.87 | $709.24 | 2.9x gamma-sensitive |
| PAYX | short | $126.01 | $83.61 | $119.93 | $134.87 | 7.0% squeeze to bull |
| AVAV | long | $148.20 | $136.68 | $159.79 | $409.83 | 22.7x spot-led |
| FRMI | long | $5.62 | $4.47 | $7.26 | $15.00 | 8.2x spot-led |
| APP | long | $298.59 | $298.59 | $298.59 | $733.60 | 43501.0x spot-led |
| BOT | long | $26.71 | $21.01 | $32.49 | $41.74 | 2.6x spot-led |

**Gemini risk notes (Aug 25):**
- INTU is the dominant slot: nearly 99% delta exposure, 3 DTE, and unstable delta means the book is carrying earnings-style convexity inside a supposedly diversified desk.
- The book is still net short delta at -148.5% even after the INTU long gamma; DASH and LYV remain the biggest squeeze vectors if momentum turns against the short stack.
- PAYX is the cleanest valuation short structurally, but it is the smallest of the main shorts; the larger short books are still fighting narratives that can stay expensive longer than expected.
- FRMI keeps the long tail risk alive: high IV and a story-stock tape mean the position can move independently of everything else, in both directions.

*Levels are authored bear/base/bull reference bands from the hypothesis table, not refreshed intrinsic-value DCF models. Confidence remains low until those valuation models are re-underwritten.*
